newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Comalco NZ targets cost reductions at smelter.
newsitem.headline: Comalco NZ targets cost reductions at smelter.

text.p: Comalco New Zealand said on Monday that it was reviewing the operations of its Tiwai Point smelter as a further step in a cost reduction programme.
The company said the review would initially examine support and service roles and there would inevitably be some reduction in jobs in these areas.
It hoped the reductions would be achieved by voluntary means, and there would be little, if any, impact on people working in the operating and production parts of the smelter.

A statement said the company's cost performance had suffered recently from higher input costs and the impact of a much stronger New Zealand dollar in a weakening international market. It had also been dealing with cost increases associated with the commissioning of a NZ$465 million upgrade.

The review of service and support roles was expected to take at least a month, and would be followed in February by a much longer review looking at the processes and costs of the metal-producing section of the smelter.
Comalco NZ is a unit of Comalco Ltd.
